title: Page 7
content_zh:
对无烟放手，她的心很痛，但如果不放手，无烟的一切都会被毁去，她的心会更痛，更是永远都无法原谅自己！
原来属于她的幸福这么短暂就必须结束了，她就算再舍不得，也不得不舍下……
“梁姑娘，反正你还有一天的时间可以考虑，我也不会要你现在就给我答案，明天……你就自己看着办吧。”楚婉冷哼一声，转身离开房间，让梁昭颖继续挣扎痛苦下去。
她有十足的把握，梁昭颖绝对会低头认输，最后的赢家，肯定是她！
隔天，戚无烟坐在绣坊的花厅里，听着他特别派去调查事情的属下将结果告诉他。
百鸟朝凤图的副本消失的事情他已经知道了，在他知道的那一刻，他马上派属下一一询问在绣坊内工作的人，看最近有没有谁的行为怪异，希望能查出到底是谁将副本带走。
这阵子他所烦恼的，其实是图稿副本消失的这件事，因为涉及要给太后的贺寿绣屏，如果处理得不好，无戚布庄肯定会招来祸事，严重性可是非同小可。
“二公子，属下已经问过绣坊内所有的人，也发现最有嫌疑带走图稿的人可能是谁了。”
“是谁？”
“非常有可能是一一楚婉。”
“为什么？”他讶异地微微挑眉，如果真的是楚婉，事情会更加棘手。
“有位绣娘曾经见过原本该在家休息的楚婉回到绣坊，而且是挑中午大家几乎都离开用膳的时候，眼神举止都有些奇怪，从时间点来推算，图稿消失也是在这件事情之后，可疑处不少。”
如果图稿真的在楚婉手上，她到底想做什么？如果她将图稿外流给其它人，那就糟糕了！
但现在没有任何确切的证据，能证明偷走图稿的人真的是楚婉，所以不宜当面质问她这件事，免得状况会越来越糟。
他不明白楚婉到底在想些什么，目前最要紧的事是防止图稿外流，所以他必须派人在暗地里监视楚婉，以防她真的是偷走图稿的人，还做出出卖无戚布庄的事情。
“你去一趟无戚镳局找我三弟，我想借用三弟的手下，暗中监视楚婉，如果她有任何异样的行为举止，赶紧让我知道……”
在戚无烟吩咐完细节之后，属下便领命离开花厅，赶紧去无戚镳局，不敢耽误任何一丁点时间。
在属下离去之后，过没多久，换梁昭颖出现在花厅门外，漾着笑走进来。
“无烟。”她轻声唤道。
“昭颖？”戚无烟赶紧收起原本凝重的神情，等着她走过来。“怎么又跑来找我，你最近会不会太清闲了点呀？”

她一靠近，他才发现她眼下的暗影，好像是没有睡好一样，她的脸上虽然带着笑，却让他感到精神似乎有些不振，好像非常努力地在勉强自己笑似的。
“昭颖，怎么了？”他担心地拉住她的手，没想到却被她不太自然地避开，他讶异地一愣，不懂她是怎么了。
“无烟，我有些话想跟你说，不会耽误太久的时间，说完我就要走了。”她假装没发现他讶异的神情，力持平静地说。
“你想说什么？”
“其实……我想了很久，才终于做出这样的决定。”梁昭颖笑着搔搔头，刻意表现出一副有些轻浮的态度。“我一直以为自己是真的非常喜欢你，但当两人订下婚约之后，我才发现……似乎并不是这样。”
“昭颖，我不懂你的意思。”戚无烟大蹙起眉，突然有种非常不好的预感。
“意思就是，当我好不容易真正得到你之后，我才发现，其实我根本就没有自己想象中的那么喜欢你。”她干笑几声，有些尴尬、不好意思。“这就像越是得不到的东西，就越让人想要用尽办法得到手，但是到手了之后，新鲜感一退去，才会发现，其实自己根本没有那么喜欢那样东西。”
戚无烟不敢置信，她居然说得出这种话来伤害他。“昭颖，别开这种玩笑，有些玩笑是开不得的。”
她的意思是她根本就不爱他？在两人经历了那么多风风雨雨，甚至都已经订下婚约的现在，她才来说自己一点都不爱他，这算什么？在他都已经放下那么多感情，只认定她一个之后，她才反过来打他一巴掌，给他这样的羞辱，他怎么可能有办法接受？“我不是特地来跟你开玩笑，我是认真的。”梁昭颖终于收起笑脸，用着非常认真的表情，一字一句清楚地说道：“戚无烟，其实我对你的占有并不是爱，只是一时的虚荣心作祟，别的女人得不到的戚无烟终于让我得到手，虽然刚开始感到很得意，但得意过了之后，就什么都没有了，我对你也就再没有任何兴趣。”
看着他因受到打击而苍白的脸色，她的心也跟着刺痛，但她却只能强忍住心中的痛楚，继续刺激他，绝不能心软。
她被迫只能用这种方式保护他、保护无戚布庄，就算他会因此而恨她，她也只能咬牙忍下，不敢让他知道真相。
她真的爱他呀，但现在的她却不能承认这件事，还得反过来让他误会她，硬生生将他从自己的身旁推开……
“昭颖，别再说了……”他不想相信她刚才所说的那些话，他不信她真的不爱他，这其中一定有什么不对劲。
“不管你想不想听，我都得说。”梁昭颖强忍住鼻头的酸涩，狠心开口道：“我要退婚，趁着现在还有转圜的余地，赶紧放手吧。”
他猛然从椅子上站起身，激动地说：“我不答应！”
这一刻，他恍若天崩地裂般的震愕不已，瞬间被深沉的绝望黑暗笼罩，他最爱的女人居然狠心地说要退婚，完全不管这么做对他简直是强烈的打击，会让他痛苦不堪，甚至心神俱碎！
为什么？她为什么要这样伤害他？他不相信这是她的真心话，她肯定隐瞒了他什么！
“就算你不答应，我婚还是退定了，我会请娘将聘礼全数退还给戚家，从此之后，你我之间，男婚女嫁各不相干，请你别再来管我的事情。”好不容易狠下心将话说完，她赶紧转身离开，就怕会在他面前压抑不住地痛哭出来。
“昭颖，等等！”戚无烟不死心地抓住她的手。“我不相信你真的对我一点感情都没有……”
“放开我！”她狠狠地将他的手甩开，不顾一切地冲出花厅，再也不想留下来听他说任何话。

“昭颖一一”戚无烟跟着赶紧追出去，说什么都不肯放手！
第9章(1)
梁昭颖匆匆地离开无戚绣坊，像是不要命似地一路狂奔，也不管自己到底喘不喘得过气来。
她咬着牙，在人来人往的街道上疾行，就算累也不让自己停下脚步，不让戚无烟有机会追上她。
“昭颖一一”
她绝不能在这个关头功亏一篑，她一定要撑下去，就算得承受痛彻心肺的心酸折磨，她也得苦苦忍下，不能给他任何一丁点希望。
好不容易，她终于回到自己家里，一入家门，她立刻虚脱地跪坐在地，气息喘急，脸色苍白得像是随时都会昏倒一样，简直吓坏了守门的门仆。
“小姐，您是怎么了？”
“快、快把门给关上！”她赶紧催促门仆。“别让戚无烟进来，快点！”
“是。”门仆虽然不知道发生什么事，还是赶紧照办，将大门给关起。
门关上后没多久，戚无烟也追到梁家门前，拼命拍打门板，没想到梁昭颖居然狠心绝情到这种地步，直接将他隔绝在外。
content_en:
Her heart hurts when she lets go of Wu Yan, but if she doesn't let go, everything about Wu Yan will be destroyed, her heart will hurt even more, and she will never be able to forgive herself!
It turned out that the happiness that belonged to her had to end in such a short period of time. Even if she couldn't let it go, she had to let it go...
"Miss Liang, you still have one day to think about it anyway, and I won't ask you to give me the answer now. Tomorrow... you can figure it out yourself." Chu Wan snorted coldly, turned around and left the room, leaving Liang Zhaoying to continue struggling and suffering.
She is absolutely sure that Liang Zhaoying will definitely bow her head and admit defeat. The final winner will definitely be her!
The next day, Qi Wuyan sat in the flower hall of the embroidery workshop, listening to the subordinates he specially sent to investigate the matter tell him the results.
He already knew about the disappearance of the copy of "Hundred Birds Facing Phoenix". The moment he found out, he immediately sent his subordinates to ask the people working in the embroidery workshop one by one to see if anyone had behaved strangely recently, hoping to find out who took the copy away.
What worries him right now is actually the disappearance of the copy of the artwork, because it involves embroidering a screen for the Queen Mother's birthday. If it is not handled well, Wuqi Buzhuang will definitely cause trouble, and the seriousness is not trivial.
"Second Young Master, my subordinates have asked everyone in the embroidery workshop and found out who is most likely to be the person who took away the artwork."
"Who is it?"
"It's very possible that it's Yiyi Chuwan."
"Why?" He raised his eyebrows slightly in surprise. If it was really Chu Wan, things would be even more difficult.
"An embroidery lady once saw Chu Wan, who was supposed to be resting at home, returning to the embroidery workshop. It was at noon when almost everyone had left for dinner. Her eyes and behavior were a little strange. Judging from the time, the artwork disappeared after this incident. There are many suspicious things."
If the artwork is really in Chu Wan's hands, what exactly does she want to do? It would be terrible if she leaked the artwork to someone else!
But now there is no definite evidence to prove that the person who stole the artwork is really Chu Wan, so it is not appropriate to question her about this in person, lest the situation will get worse.
He didn't understand what Chu Wan was thinking. The most important thing at the moment was to prevent the artwork from leaking out, so he had to send someone to secretly monitor Chu Wan in case she really stole the artwork and betrayed Wuqi Cloth Village.
"You go to the Wuqi Bureau to find my third brother. I want to use my third brother's men to spy on Chu Wan. If she behaves in any strange way, please let me know quickly..."
After Qi Wuyan finished giving the details, his subordinates took the order to leave the flower hall and hurried to Wu Qi's Bureau, not daring to waste any time.
After his subordinates left, not long after, Liang Zhaoying appeared outside the flower hall door and walked in with a smile.
"No smoke." She called softly.
"Zhaoying?" Qi Wuyan quickly put away his solemn expression and waited for her to come over. "Why are you coming to see me again? Have you been too leisurely recently?"
As soon as she got closer, he noticed the shadows under her eyes, as if she hadn't slept well. Although there was a smile on her face, he felt a little depressed, as if she was trying very hard to force herself to smile.
"Zhao Ying, what's wrong?" He held her hand worriedly, but she unexpectedly avoided her unnaturally. He was stunned for a moment, not understanding what was wrong with her.
"Wu Yan, I have something to tell you. It won't take too long. After I finish speaking, I'm leaving." She pretended not to notice his surprised expression and said calmly.
"What do you want to say?"
"Actually... I thought about it for a long time before finally making this decision." Liang Zhaoying smiled and scratched her head, deliberately showing a somewhat frivolous attitude. "I always thought that I really liked you, but after the two of us made an engagement, I realized...it didn't seem to be the case."
"Zhaoying, I don't understand what you mean." Qi Wuyan frowned and suddenlyI have a very bad feeling.
"It means that after I finally got you, I realized that I actually don't like you as much as I thought." She laughed dryly, feeling a little embarrassed and embarrassed. "It's like the more unobtainable something is, the more people want to do everything they can to get it. But after they get it, once the novelty wears off, they realize that they actually don't like that thing that much at all."
Qi Wuyan couldn't believe that she could actually say such words to hurt him. "Zhaoying, don't make such jokes. Some jokes are not allowed."
Does she mean she doesn't love him at all? After the two of them had gone through so many ups and downs and had even entered into an engagement, she just said that she didn't love him at all. What does this mean? After he had put aside so many emotions and only identified with her, she slapped him in turn and gave him such humiliation. How could he accept it? "I'm not here to joke with you, I'm serious." Liang Zhaoying finally put away her smile and said clearly word for word with a very serious expression: "Qi Wuyan, in fact, my possession of you is not love, it is just a temporary vanity. Qi Wuyan finally got my hands on what other women couldn't get. Although I felt very proud at first, after the pride passed, there was nothing left, and I no longer have any interest in you."
Seeing his pale face due to the blow, her heart also stung, but she could only hold back the pain in her heart and continue to stimulate him, and she must not be soft-hearted.
She was forced to protect him and Wuqi Buzhuang in this way. Even if he would hate her for it, she could only grit her teeth and endure it, not daring to let him know the truth.
She really loves him, but now she can't admit it. She has to make him misunderstand her and forcefully push him away from her...
"Zhaoying, stop talking..." He didn't want to believe what she just said. He didn't believe that she really didn't love him. There must be something wrong with it.
"Whether you want to hear it or not, I have to say it." Liang Zhaoying suppressed the sourness in her nose and said cruelly: "I want to break off the engagement. Let it go while there is still room for change."
He suddenly stood up from his chair and said excitedly: "I won't agree!"
At this moment, he was as shocked as if the earth was shattering, and he was instantly shrouded in the darkness of deep despair. The woman he loved most cruelly said that she wanted to break off the engagement, completely ignoring that doing so would be a strong blow to him, and would make him miserable and even heartbroken!
Why? Why would she hurt him like this? He didn't believe that she was telling the truth, she must be hiding something from him!
"Even if you don't agree, my marriage is still cancelled. I will ask my mother to return all the betrothal gifts to the Qi family. From now on, marriage between men and women has nothing to do with me. Please stop meddling in my affairs." After finally finishing her words, she quickly turned around and left, fearing that she would burst into tears uncontrollably in front of him.
"Zhaoying, wait!" Qi Wuyan grabbed her hand without giving up. "I don't believe you really have no feelings for me at all..."
"Let me go!" She slammed his hand away and rushed out of the flower hall desperately, never wanting to stay and listen to anything he said.
"Zhaoying Yiyi" Qi Wuyan followed and chased out quickly, refusing to let go no matter what!
Chapter 9(1)
Liang Zhaoying hurriedly left Wuqi Embroidery Workshop, running as fast as she could for her life, not caring whether she could catch her breath or not.
She gritted her teeth and walked quickly on the crowded streets, not letting herself stop even if she was tired, not giving Qi Wuyan a chance to catch up with her.
"Zhaoying Yiyi"
She must not fall short at this juncture, she must hold on, even if she has to endure heart-wrenching heartache, she must endure it without giving him any hope.Finally, she finally returned to her home. As soon as she entered the house, she immediately knelt down on the ground exhausted, breathing heavily, and her face was as pale as if she would faint at any time, which frightened the doorman guarding the door.
"Miss, what's wrong with you?"
"Hurry, close the door!" She quickly urged the doorman. "Don't let Qi Wuyan come in, hurry up!"
"Yes." Although the doorman didn't know what happened, he quickly followed the instructions and closed the door.
Not long after the door closed, Qi Wuyan also chased him to the door of Liang's house and slapped the door panel as hard as he could. Unexpectedly, Liang Zhaoying was so heartless and heartless that she directly cut him off.
